To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the TOMM40 poly T rs10524523 (523)'short' variant is associated with better cognitive performance among elderly with type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus, and that this effect is independent of the APOE genotype.
the TOMM40 polyT '523' variant was found to be significantly associated with cognitive performance in a group of elderly with type 1 diabetes, independently from the effect of the APOE polymorphism.
the short allele of the TOMM 40 poly-T variant (rs10524523) was associated with better cognitive performance in elderly with diabetes, compared to the long and very long alleles.
In summary, our research is concerned with

understanding the genetic factors associated with cognitive decline and dementia, and with the identification of genetic risk factors that could potentially lead to the development of new therapeutic targets for prevention and treatment of these disorders.
the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms that underlie the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease (AD), and the relationship between type-2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and AD.
the identification of factors that may contribute to the development of AD in elderly with diabetes, a group that is particularly at high risk for cognitive decline and AD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TOMM40 poly T variant is associated with better cognitive performance among non demented elderly with Type 2 Diabetes.
TOMM40 rs10524523 is associated with cognition in the elderly, but that its effect is independent of APOE genotype.
the TOMM40 '523' variant is associated with better cognitive performance among non- demented elderly with diabetes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the S allele is a protective factor for cognitive decline in elderly with type 1 diabetes, and in elderly with type II diabetes.
the TOMM40 poly T rs10524523 S/S variant is associated with better cognitive performance among non demented elderly with diabetes.
the S/S genotype of TOMM40 rs10524523 is associated with better cognitive performance in elderly with type 1 diabetes, independently from the status of APOE.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TOMM40 poly T variant rs10524523 is associated with cognitive function in elderly with type 1 diabetes, independently from APOE status.
the TOMM40 rs10524523 '523' variant is associated with better performance on tests of executive function and episodic memory in a sample of elderly with type 1 diabetes.
the TOMM40 polyT rs10524523 '523' variant is associated with executive function and memory performance among non-dementia Jewish elderly with type-2 diabetes.
